title: Search migration (SQLite FTS -> NDJSON postings)
legacy: server.js /api/search used SQLite FTS (LIKE prefix semantics)
ndjson: query-engine.cjs search() + data-loader searchIndex(letter) + index-builder pass2

postings.buckets: 37 files (a-z, 0-9, other) keyed by first char; keys sorted; per key -> id array
postings.prefix_match: binary search over sorted keys: all keys starting with query prefix (LIKE 'prefix%' parity)

query_semantics.multi_word: per-word id sets intersected (AND), each word prefix-matched
query_semantics.relevance_order: count-based deterministic (id string sort on ties) — matches FTS ordering verified by parity suite
query_semantics.filters: difficulty/subject/year/etc. applied after id selection via matcher
query_semantics.paging: offset/limit over the final sorted list; total = filtered count

verification.regression: search.hit.shape PASS (rows carry optionA-D, relatedQuestions, chapter_name/topic_name)
verification.bench: search_hot 3856ms cold (bucket read), search_warm 1158ms with cached bucket; SQLite equivalent 3.2-3.6ms (FTS index)

known_gap: cold searches re-read the letter bucket from disk once per process per letter (bounded by 32MB cache)
